pro_intro.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: Ah! A new trainer on the coast. Welcome!
I'm DR. JOSEPHSON. Around here they call me the TEA PROFESSOR.
I study this region's creatures... but mostly its gossip.

pro_name.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
pro_name.prompt: Hmm. You look familiar. Are you one of my interns? Remind me of your name?

pro_recognize.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: {name}?! Of course! The LOVEBOAT!
Back in BMB, rumors reached me about a certain new couple.
So I called LEON. Told him I knew, and that I had plans.
He checked with you first. Very responsible of him.
Then I gave you two the LOVEBOAT AWARD in front of the whole class!
Back then, I was the sneaky one.
This time... it's LEON who's up to something.
But I've said too much! Let's find you a partner.

pro_starter.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: I've prepared THREE for you. Choose wisely!

pro_starter_lactaid.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: LACTAID! A classic defensive partner.
It blocks all DAIRY-type attacks. Ice cream fears it.
...LACTAID is only needed occasionally. It rolled off to wait for dessert.

pro_starter_tennis.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: TENNIS BALLS! Straight from your college tennis days.
Fast, bouncy, and a little fuzzy.
...TENNIS BALLS bounced right out the window. Out of bounds!

pro_starter_pick_last.prompt: Hm? Someone's peeking out from under the table...

pro_starter_mystery_locked.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: Hmm. That one's hiding under the table.
She's shy. Try the others first.
Something crawls out from under the table...
It's GIDGET!
GIDGET sat directly on your foot.

pro_starter_gidget_chosen.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: Well! It seems she's chosen YOU.
GIDGET joined your team!

pro_starter_charm.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: One more thing! A gift for your new partner.
He hands you a tiny golden CANELE CHARM.

choices.label: EAT IT
fail: It's a charm, not a pastry.

lines: You clip the CANELE CHARM onto GIDGET's collar.
It jingles. GIDGET looks extremely proud of herself.

pro_starter_charm_safe.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: Keep it safe. Caneles have a way of unlocking things...

pro_lodging.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: Oh! I nearly forgot. LEON dropped off two brochures this morning.
He said you'd need somewhere to rest. And that YOU get to choose.
{partner} knocked the HIDEOUT brochure off the table!
{partner} has decided. It's the SEASIDE INN!

pro_lodging_inn.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: The SEASIDE INN! Right on the beach, with a fireplace in every room.
GIDGET has already claimed the spot by the fire.
And breakfast is on the house.

pro_lodging_hideout.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: The SECRET HIDEOUT! A retro loft, a short walk from the beach.
Sunsets from the bed. A record player. An ARCADE MACHINE.
GIDGET is already going for the high score.

pro_sunflower.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: A little bird told me there's a sunflower field along your route.
A detour could be... blooming lovely.

pro_sunflower_yes.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: Wonderful! You may come home with an armful.

pro_sunflower_yes_pose.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: GIDGET is practicing her sitting-in-flowers pose.

pro_sunflower_no.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: No problem. More time for the coast!

pro_dinner.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: Now, the grand finale: an anniversary FEAST.
Stay on the coast... or head home to the city?

pro_dinner_city_only.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: Now, the grand finale: an anniversary FEAST in the city!

pro_dinner_coastside.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: A pasta house right here on the coast! Handmade pasta.
No drive home. Just dinner and the ocean air.

pro_dinner_city.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: A few fine tables await. Choose one!

pro_ending.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: Splendid! Your choices have been recorded.
Now... about LEON's secret.
I'm sworn to silence. But I can tell you three things.
ONE: Keep OCT 10 and OCT 11 free.
TWO: Have a bag packed by Saturday afternoon. LEON will take it from there.
THREE: Your first badge awaits at the GALA.
Oh, and pack something fancy, something cozy,
something sturdy to walk in, and something to sleep in.
The rest? You'll discover it one badge at a time.

pro_replay_start.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: Back for another look? Splendid!
A word of warning: any new picks replace your old ones.
If you change anything, be sure to tell LEON!

pro_card.shareText: Trainer {name} chose GIDGET! Picks are in. Keeping Oct 10–11 free... LEON, I'm onto you. 👀

lines: What a night! {name} dazzled everyone at the GALA.
LEON appears with your bag. Perfect timing.

ch1_start_leon.speaker: LEON
lines: Your next adventure awaits. To the car!
The road winds off into the dark.
GIDGET curled up and fell asleep!
You arrive at {L.lodging}. It's late. Very late.
GIDGET wakes up and immediately explores the room.
You arrive at {L.lodging}. It's late. Very late.
GIDGET wakes up and immediately explores the room.
WOW! You found the ANCIENT FAMILY HEIRLOOM CHEST!
Passed down for generations. Priceless beyond measure.
GIDGET is already sitting on it.

choices.label: INSPECT IT
fail: GIDGET is in the way. She does not care about your inspection.

choices.label: CHASE GIDGET OFF
fail: GIDGET stares at you. GIDGET is not moving.

lines: THE WASIAN bursts into the room!

ch1_heirloom_wasian.speaker: THE WASIAN
lines: NOT THE HEIRLOOM! MY GREAT-GREAT-GRANDMOTHER'S CHEST!
THE WASIAN bursts into tears and flips it over to check for damage.
There's a sticker on the bottom.
MICHAELS. $24.99. 40% OFF. MADE IN CHINA.
THE WASIAN quietly leaves the room.
The ANCIENT FAMILY HEIRLOOM CHEST was added to your Bag.
Morning on the coast. The sun is out. GIDGET is already hungry.
A reminder: LEON once went to the wrong ANDYTOWN. Twice.
Good news: breakfast is right here at the inn. What could go wrong?
Morning on the coast. The sun is out. GIDGET is already hungry.
A reminder: LEON once went to the wrong ANDYTOWN. Twice.
Good news: breakfast is right here at the hideout. What could go wrong?

ch2_directions.speaker: LEON
lines: No directions needed. I can't get this one wrong.
LEON walks confidently into the closet.
{name} wants to try a bit of everything. To share.
LEON is guarding his plate.

choices.label: STEAL A BITE
fail: LEON blocks with his fork. Impressive reflexes.

choices.label: ASK NICELY
fail: LEON pretends not to hear you.

lines: LEON cannot resist. Plates are swapped. Everything is split.
You got to try everything. As planned.
A whole field of sunflowers, taller than LEON.
GIDGET disappears between the stalks.
LEON hands you a pair of CUTTERS.
You found the perfect sunflower.

choices.label: PULL IT
fail: The sunflower is stronger than it looks.

choices.label: ASK GIDGET
fail: GIDGET is watching a bee very carefully.

lines: Snip! The SUNFLOWER was added to your Bag.
GIDGET sniffs it and approves.
The tide is out. The rocks are full of tiny pools.
GIDGET peers into the water, very seriously.
The SEA STAR is just sitting there. Being a star.

choices.label: PICK IT UP
fail: GIDGET gives you a look. It lives here.

choices.label: POKE IT
fail: The SEA STAR does not move. It has all day.

lines: Click! A perfect shot of the SEA STAR.
The sun is getting low. One more stop tonight.
GIDGET's stomach growls. It must be lunchtime.
LEON drives confidently to the wrong place.

ch5_wrongturn_leon.speaker: LEON
lines: Huh. There must be two of them.
You made it to PILOT LIGHT. GIDGET settles in to watch the planes.
You made it to CANTINA. GIDGET curls up by the fire pit.
TODO: A quiet rest stop. There's an easel here...
TODO: Bonus scene: a masterpiece!
TODO: Onward.
Lunch was a success. GIDGET is very full.
Your nervous system has two settings. Which will it be?
You head out for a walk along the bluffs.
The wind picks up. Heart rate: climbing.
GIDGET trots ahead, tail high. Sympathetic system: engaged.
You find somewhere cozy to recover.
Heart rate: down. Lunch: digesting.
GIDGET is already asleep. Parasympathetic system: engaged.
The sun is sinking toward the ocean. A fire pit crackles.
A familiar figure sips his tea by the fire. It's DR. JOSEPHSON.

ch7_start_josephson.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: Two years, TRAINER {name}. Let's see what you've learned.
LEON steps up beside you. Your team is ready.

ch7_win_josephson.speaker: DR. JOSEPHSON
lines: Splendid! You two make quite the team.
The sun slips below the horizon.
GIDGET curls up by the fire, very proud of herself.

ch7_win_leon.speaker: LEON
lines: One last stop. Let's go eat.
